title: ZenthraSystemsAgentToolDefinitions
description: JSON Schemas and specifications for tools connected to the Zenthra Systems n8n AI Agent

tools.name: search_knowledge_base
tools.description: Searches Zenthra Systems verified documentation for capabilities, case studies (e.g. Cyclistic bike-share analytics), service offerings, SLAs, technical architectures, and company information.

query.description: The search query or keyword phrase (e.g., 'Cyclistic bike-share case study', 'n8n self hosting vs cloud', 'invoicing automation')

tools.name: save_qualified_lead
tools.description: Persists qualified lead details and an AI-generated discovery memo into Zenthra Systems' CRM/Database (Airtable, HubSpot, or PostgreSQL). Must be invoked before providing a calendar booking link.

company_name.description: Name of the prospect's company or organization

core_process_to_automate.description: Detailed description of the manual bottleneck or system to automate

current_tech_stack.description: Current software tools, databases, or APIs involved (e.g., HubSpot, Shopify, PostgreSQL, Slack)

estimated_budget_or_volume.description: Estimated monthly lead/task volume or budget scope if mentioned

discovery_memo.description: A concise 3-4 sentence technical briefing written for Zenthra's engineering team summarizing problem, proposed architecture, and key risks.

qualification_status.description: Assessed intent level based on rubric

tools.name: get_booking_link
tools.description: Generates a prefilled 30-minute Technical Discovery Session calendar link for the prospective client.

full_name.description: Client's full name for pre-filling the booking form

work_email.description: Client's email for calendar invite dispatch

meeting_topic.description: Short description of meeting scope (e.g., 'n8n Automation Discovery')

tools.name: notify_internal_team
tools.description: Dispatches an instantaneous priority alert to Zenthra Systems' internal Slack/Discord/Telegram channel.

summary_message.description: Formatted message payload for the notification channel
